content.value_statement: Unclear writing can hide good ideas and slow review. This skill edits grammar, tone, structure, and concision for cleaner drafts.
actual_capabilities: Proofreads spelling, grammar, punctuation, capitalization, and formatting consistency.
Improves word choice, sentence structure, terminology consistency, and redundant phrasing.
Reviews paragraph flow, transitions, tone consistency, pacing, and clarity of expression.
Checks organization, argument strength, missing information, redundant sections, and overall effectiveness.
Provides edited text with a summary of changes and key improvements.
Can explain line-by-line edits with original text, revised text, and editing rationale.
limitations: It needs user-provided text and editing goals to produce useful revisions.
It cannot guarantee factual accuracy without reliable source material from the user.
It may not preserve specialized voice or brand rules unless those rules are provided.
It does not replace legal, medical, academic, or compliance review for high-stakes content.

use_cases.title: Polish Business Drafts
use_cases.description: Revise emails, proposals, reports, and announcements for concise and professional communication.

use_cases.title: Improve Long-Form Writing
use_cases.description: Strengthen structure, transitions, tone, and readability in articles, essays, and documentation.

use_cases.title: Review Learning Materials
use_cases.description: Make course notes, tutorials, and explanations clearer for readers with different experience levels.

prompt_templates.title: Quick Proofread
prompt_templates.prompt: Proofread this text for grammar, spelling, punctuation, and obvious clarity issues. Keep the meaning unchanged: [paste text]

prompt_templates.title: Concise Revision
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate editing for clarity and brevity.
prompt_templates.prompt: Edit this draft to be clearer and more concise. Provide the revised version and a short summary of the main changes: [paste text]

prompt_templates.title: Tone and Audience Edit
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced revision with audience and voice constraints.
prompt_templates.prompt: Revise this text for [audience] using a [tone] tone. Preserve the key points, improve flow, and explain important wording changes: [paste text]

prompt_templates.title: Developmental Review
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced structural editing for complex drafts.
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this draft for structure, argument strength, missing information, and redundancy. Then provide an edited version and prioritized improvement notes: [paste text]

output_examples.input: A wordy company paragraph that repeats phrases and buries the main point.
output_examples.output: The skill returns a shorter edited paragraph, a summary of changes, and notes about concision, stronger verbs, and clarity.

output_examples.input: A draft email with grammar errors, uneven tone, and unclear next steps.
output_examples.output: The skill provides a polished email with corrected grammar, direct wording, and a clear call to action.

output_examples.input: A long article section with weak transitions and repeated ideas.
output_examples.output: The skill reorganizes the section, improves transitions, removes repetition, and explains the main structural improvements.

best_practices: Provide the full text, audience, purpose, and desired tone before asking for edits.
Ask for a specific editing level, such as proofreading, copy editing, line editing, or developmental editing.
Review the explanation of changes before accepting edits for sensitive or specialized content.
anti_patterns: Do not ask for a full rewrite when you only need a grammar check.
Do not omit audience, tone, or formatting requirements for professional content.
Do not treat suggested edits as final facts without checking names, numbers, and claims.

faq.question: What type of editing does this skill support?
faq.answer: It supports proofreading, copy editing, line editing, and developmental editing.

faq.question: Can it preserve my original meaning?
faq.answer: Yes, ask it to preserve meaning and explain any changes that may affect emphasis.

faq.question: Can it edit formal business writing?
faq.answer: Yes, it can improve emails, reports, proposals, announcements, and other professional drafts.

faq.question: Does it fact-check content?
faq.answer: It can flag claims that need review, but users should verify facts with reliable sources.

faq.question: Can it show line-by-line edits?
faq.answer: Yes, ask for detailed edits to receive original text, edited text, and a reason for each change.

faq.question: Which AI tools can use this skill?
faq.answer: The report lists compatibility with Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.
